svg.title: Make monitoring expectations explicit
svg.desc: Illustration labels: Monitoring policy: make the process visible; Purpose and activity recorded; Who can access the records; Retention and review process; A policy does not override applicable workplace or privacy requirements.. Purpose and scope: What is recorded, and why?. Handling: Who can access records, and how are they kept?. Requirements: Which laws and organisational processes apply?

g.text: Monitoring policy: make the process visible
A policy does not override applicable workplace or privacy requirements.
